title.en: After a directory rename: scripts, history and Linux permissions
title.zh: 目录改名之后：启动脚本、历史链接与 Linux 权限

summary.en: Why moving code into frontend/backend also requires checking build entry points, old working copies and the Maven wrapper executable bit.
summary.zh: 一次 frontend／backend 目录整理，为什么还要检查构建入口、旧工作副本和 Maven wrapper 的可执行标记。

basis.en: Based on public Shuyang Home v1.2.2 source, test fixtures and release records. Existing behavior, recorded checks and proposed tests are distinguished; this update is a source review and write-up.
basis.zh: 依据沭阳之家 v1.2.2 的公开源码、测试夹具与版本记录整理。文中区分已有实现、历史验证和建议补测；本次是代码阅读与内容整理。

title.en: Find the entry points that depend on paths

paragraphs.en: Old business names at the source root made the project harder to understand. Renaming the directories to frontend and backend clarifies their purpose, but paths are also an interface shared by scripts, configuration and documentation.
paragraphs.zh: 项目名称变了，源码根目录还沿用旧业务的名称，新读者很难判断仓库是做什么的。整理成 frontend 和 backend 能减少这种困惑，但目录名也是脚本、配置和文档共同使用的接口。

paragraphs.en: The migration touched startup, preview, tests, versioning and packaging. Updating editor references alone can miss PowerShell scripts, CI working directories and paths assembled in Python.
paragraphs.zh: 这次迁移需要同时检查启动、预览、测试、版本管理和打包入口。只修复编辑器中的引用，未必能覆盖 PowerShell 脚本、CI 的工作目录，以及 Python 中拼接出来的文件路径。

bullets.en: List startup scripts, package.json tasks, workflows, packaging scripts and README commands.
bullets.zh: 先列入口：启动脚本、package.json、工作流、打包脚本和 README 中的命令。

bullets.en: Check whether each path is relative to the repository, the current working directory or the script itself.
bullets.zh: 再看路径语义：相对仓库根目录、当前工作目录还是脚本所在目录。

bullets.en: Run the real entry points from the new layout to check that they resolve correctly.
bullets.zh: 最后从新目录运行实际命令，确认修改后的入口可用。

title.en: Keep current entry points accurate and historical evidence traceable
title.zh: 当前入口要改，历史证据要能追溯

paragraphs.en: A migration inventory records the paths that existed before cleanup. Source links pinned to an older commit must also use paths from that commit; replacing only the directory name can create a 404.
paragraphs.zh: 迁移清单记录的是清理前的路径，保留原名才有意义。笔记中的源码链接如果固定到旧提交，也必须使用那个提交中的路径；把链接里的目录直接换成新名称，反而会产生 404。

paragraphs.en: An older working copy may contain ignored data, uploads and environment configuration. Upgrade instructions should help readers identify and migrate these files. A public source cleanup is not permission to overwrite a running application directory.
paragraphs.zh: 旧工作副本还可能保存被 Git 忽略的数据、上传文件和环境配置。升级说明需要先让读者辨认这些内容，再迁移到新路径。公开源码的目录整理不等于可以覆盖正在运行的业务目录。

title.en: Working on Windows does not prove a Linux file is executable
title.zh: Windows 能运行，不代表 Linux 能执行

paragraphs.en: After the v1.2.1 directory migration, v1.2.2 restored the executable bit on backend/mvnw. Its content was unchanged, but Git needed mode 100755 rather than 100644 for Linux workflows that invoke ./mvnw.
paragraphs.zh: v1.2.1 完成目录迁移后，还需要在 v1.2.2 恢复 backend/mvnw 的可执行标记。文件内容没有变化，但 Git 记录的模式应为 100755；如果变成 100644，Linux 工作流中的 ./mvnw 可能直接报权限错误。

paragraphs.en: Windows builds can miss this because they use mvnw.cmd. Reviewing the target platform entry point is necessary in addition to reviewing content diffs.
paragraphs.zh: 这类问题容易漏过 Windows 本地构建，因为 Windows 用的是 mvnw.cmd。检查目标系统的启动入口，比只看文件内容 diff 更有用。

code.text:
git ls-files --stage -- backend/mvnw
# Expected mode: 100755

# If the tracked mode is wrong, repair it and review the diff:
git update-index --chmod=+x backend/mvnw
git diff --cached --summary

title.en: Attach verification to the version it describes

paragraphs.en: The release history records Web/mobile type checks, 68 frontend logic checks, 63 backend tests, three builds and verification of 140 packaged files for v1.2.1. Version 1.2.2 repairs file mode and version consistency while referencing those earlier business checks.
paragraphs.zh: 版本记录中，v1.2.1 在新目录下完成了 Web／移动端类型检查、68 项前端逻辑检查、63 项后端测试、三端构建，以及 140 份包内文件的校验。v1.2.2 修复文件模式和版本一致性，沿用此前的业务验证记录。

callout.en: The practical lesson is to treat a directory rename as a small migration: it changes both the paths readers follow and the paths machines execute.
callout.zh: 这次整理最值得保留的经验：目录改名是一项小迁移。它同时影响读者找到代码的路径和机器执行代码的路径。
